notes: Current USMLE immune outline supports inherited leukocyte-function defects.

blueprint.competency: Medical Knowledge: Applying Foundational Science Concepts

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Normal beta-2 integrin expression with impaired rolling, persistent neutrophilia and SLC35C1 loss identifies LAD-II from defective fucosylated selectin ligands.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: CD18 deficiency causes LAD-I and failure of firm adhesion rather than the rolling defect; MPO, NADPH oxidase and C3 deficiencies affect killing/opsonization rather than endothelial rolling.
